title: Pichia pastoris Strain and Growth Condition
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8hcht2w
materials: Inoculate growth medium with single positive colony

steps.title: Initial Cell Growth
steps.instruction: Grow Pichia pastoris cells on agar plates containing the desired antibiotic.

substeps.instruction: Incubate non-shaking at 30°C for 72 hours

steps.title: Primary Liquid Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate cells into baffled flasks containing BMGY growth medium.

substeps.instruction: Use 3 mL of growth medium in 30 mL-100 mL flasks to ensure sufficient aeration
Incubate at 30°C and 225 rpm for 24 hours (overnight)

steps.title: First Cell Harvest and Wash
steps.instruction: Harvest cells from the primary culture and perform the first wash.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cultures to sterile 50 mL falcon tubes
Centrifuge at 3,000 x g for 5 minutes
Decant the supernatant
Add 3 mL of sterile BMMY to the used baffled flasks
Swirl and transfer the solution to the corresponding falcon tube
Vortex the falcon tube
Centrifuge at 3,000 x g for 5 minutes
Decant the supernatant

steps.title: Second Medium Exchange
steps.instruction: Perform a second wash with BMMY and return to flasks.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL of fresh BMMY to the cells
Vortex the solution
Transfer the cells back to the original flasks
Add 20 µL of sterile 100% methanol to the flask
Incubate at 30°C and 225 rpm for 24 hours (overnight)

steps.title: Final Cell Harvest
steps.instruction: Harvest the induced cells from the second day of culture.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cells to 50 mL falcon tubes
Centrifuge at 3,000 x g for 5 minutes
Decant the supernatant

steps.title: Cell Resuspension and Purification
steps.instruction: Resuspend and concentrate the cell pellet.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell wall containing pellet in 1 mL water
Transfer the suspension to a pre-weighed 2 mL tube
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 2 minutes
Decant the water
